name: PORTFOLIO_LAUNCHER_PROJECT_ROOT_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: PORTFOLIO_LAUNCHER_PROJECT_ROOT_20261107 — three cadence lanes graded DEGRADED because
each launcher hard-coded the dev checkout as PROJECT_ROOT. The systemd controller runs
is the served release, but the launchers it dispatches (run_portfolio.sh, _weekly, _monthly)
executed a hard-coded dev checkout instead. So a cadence ran code
from a tree the release train never updates: the 2026-11-06 12:30Z daily run died in _get_sector
with AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'upper' — a bug already fixed in the
release that had launched it (c072bb634, FU-007) — and the weekly slot died in
portfolio_weekly_report.py on the same class of NoneType formatting.
The default now follows the launcher's own tree (BASH_SOURCE); PROJECT_ROOT still overrides,
The gate pins: each launcher executes its own tree, writes its log there, and honours an explicit
override; and no launcher carries an absolute default or names the dev checkout. The behavioural
tests EXECUTE the launcher and therefore SKIP while a default is absolute — executing an
unfixed launcher runs the real pipeline against live state — so the static assertions are the
ones that fail on the defect. Hermetic otherwise: stub python/python3/tee, throwaway tree, no
